name: Kayaking Barbados
summary: Kayaking Barbados runs guided sea kayak tours on the north west coast of Barbados. Tours range from a 90 minute history paddle at Speightstown to a three hour trip along the cliffs and coves of the north. They also rent kayaks, paddleboards and snorkel gear, and deliver rental kayaks anywhere on the island.
standouts: Tandem kayaks for two people sharing a boat
Rental kayaks delivered and picked up island-wide

trips.title: Rugged North
trips.summary: A three hour kayak tour along the north west coast, where the sea has cut cliffs and coves into the shore. The trip can include a visit to an old fort, or some kayak surfing with a guide watching over you.
highlights: Cliffs and coves of the north west coast
Visit to a long forgotten fort

trips.title: West Coast Sunset
trips.summary: An evening paddle on the west coast, two hours long. The route passes Six Men's, one of the island's oldest fishing villages, and the condominiums built into the cliffs at Port Ferdinand.
highlights: Passes the fishing village at Six Men's

trips.title: Historic Speightstown
trips.summary: A 90 minute paddle built around the history of Speightstown. The town was once a leading port with a direct link to England, guarded by nine forts along the north west coast, and the guide tells its story of war, piracy and survival along the way.
highlights: History of Speightstown as a port
Nine forts once guarded the north west coast
Stories brought to life through re-creations
